This search now feels precise enough for a growing collection. Exact matching for `#tag` is the right choice; partial matching could easily bring in unrelated tags, while ordinary text search already covers looser searches.

The combinations, quoted phrases, parentheses, and quoted operator words behave as I’d expect. The reminder under the box is useful without being intrusive.

For a malformed search, please show a clear message such as “Check your search—there may be an unmatched parenthesis.” Showing everything could make me think the search was accepted and that every bookmark matched. With that correction, I’m happy with the search behaviour.
